category_title: Bored students who engage in off-task behaviors
minimal_context: The student and tutor are in the classroom reviewing the assigned homework.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Please take out your homework so we can review the assignment.

STUDENT: I don't want to do our homework. Even though we do our homework, they do not check, they do not reward, so we don't have the desire to do it.

TUTOR: Let's just look at the first question on the page.

STUDENT: And sometimes they make a student to check the homework, and those students are unfair anyway.

TUTOR: We need to continue with the lesson.

STUDENT: I'm bored. Let's change the subject. Did anyone watch the game on TV last night?

options.A: Request that all questions be held until the end of class.
options.B: Create a positive and emotional classroom environment during the sessions.
options.C: Deliver a structured mindfulness program of twelve hour-long sessions.
options.D: Implement relatively tight timelines for completing the homework assignments.
